title: Can I CRUSH Mini Chess?
summary: Despite the title 'Mini Chess', he plays Minihouse on chess.com: a 6x6 board where captured pieces go to your pocket and can be dropped back (crazyhouse rules). Goal: three wins in a row vs online humans (1500, 1700, scarlet); achieved. He uses a knight-gambit opening that sacrifices the rook to open the enemy king.
rules: 6x6 board, reduced armies (king, rook, knight, bishop and 6 pawns per side; no queen seen in frames).
Crazyhouse drops: captured pieces switch colour and go to your pocket; on your turn you may drop one onto any empty square instead of moving (pawns presumably not on first/last rank).
Pawns promote on the last rank (6th).
win_condition: Checkmate. Video goal: 3 wins in a row.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; pocket piece icons beside the board; bullet clocks <1 min

setup: 6x6: White back rank on rank 1 with K, R, N, B (+? 2 more squares; order not legible), 6 pawns on rank 2; Black mirrored on ranks 6/5. Exact order unverified - see chess.com Minihouse.
